summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AMSA SMS application. Backend APIs are fully functional (28/28 tests passed) including authentication, vessel management, document management, risk assessment, crew management, maintenance, incidents, emergency procedures, compliance checklists, AI assistant with Google Gemini integration, and dashboard statistics. Frontend testing confirmed user registration, authentication, and navigation to all 7 main modules work correctly. AI integration is working properly with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash.
